name: f3-gdx-skill-distance-similarity-profiles
description: DB reader/writer for the F3_GDX_SKILL_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY_PROFILES (F3) skill: computes pairwise Euclidean, RMS and Mahalanobis distances between every pair of persons' own profile vectors (F1_GDX_SKILL_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_FEATURE_SPACE's normalized z(t), or F2_GDX_SKILL_LATENT_REPRESENTATIONS's learned h(t)), and records the result into the GDX_HNF_DISTANCE_* tables, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
